Binance flipped to a 59.3 million dollar intake from a 243.6 million dollar outflow, while Bitfinex sent out 64.5 million dollars, compared with 311.4 million dollars on the prior print, and Gemini took in 28.8 million dollars. A negative print means dollars left the venues where holders can sell, and a positive print means dollars arrived there.
